_hinweis: Example mapping, hand-maintained. Maps a raw session project name (last path segment of cwd or git root) to {projekt, kontext} -- projekt is the canonical display name in the dashboard, kontext is one of {arbeit, voice, review, bewertung, test}. A compound key `<rohname>@<quelle>` takes precedence over the plain `<rohname>` (source-dependent resolution). `codex-<x>` without its own entry auto-resolves to the alias of `<x>` (if one exists) otherwise `<x>` itself, context review. A raw name with no entry at all keeps the raw name as project and gets context 'unzugeordnet'. Missing or broken file: fail-open, no alias applied. Replace the example entries below with your own projects.
